name: Ruzi
description: Cecilee's brother who broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul.

description_citations.text: "Rubblebelt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young elf falls with her wolf from a training beam during her first lesson, and Ruzi asks her to say what she did wrong.
timeline.quote: "Tell me what you did wrong," Ruzi said to his two-legged student.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and his wolf Kuma cross the high beam without hesitation to teach his students to trust their wolves.
timeline.quote: But Ruzi urged his wolf forward without hesitation.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: The dryad Mazena confronts Ruzi after class with a message from Guildmaster Trostani.
timeline.quote: We have an important message from Guildmaster Trostani, and you kept us standing for ages,

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
timeline.quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Mazena makes clear that Ruzi must find his sister Cecilee, and he cannot say no.
timeline.quote: You want me to find my sister.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi recalls Cecilee's departure for the Rubblebelt and her silence, and that she adopted a Gruul child named for him.
timeline.quote: He'd heard that she'd adopted an abandoned Gruul child to raise as her own.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and Kuma reach the edge of the Rubblebelt before dawn and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.
timeline.quote: Hours later, Ruzi and Kuma had reached the last roof at the edge of the Rubblebelt.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee, mute from childhood, suddenly speaks in a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya at Vitu-Ghazi, and the dryads call her a conduit to the Worldsoul.
timeline.quote: And then one day Cecilee did speak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Feeling called to establish a settlement in the Rubblebelt, Cecilee ignores Ruzi's warnings and leads twenty followers there.
timeline.quote: And so she went, leading twenty followers, to the wildest place any of them could imagine.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate into the settlement, surprising Massacre Girl and her men.
timeline.quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi gutted the first cultist to attack and is surrounded, weakened by the fear that Cecilee is among the dead.
timeline.quote: Cecilee's body would be among the dead, and that knowledge made Ruzi weak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her, taunts Ruzi, and leaves with her cultists, throwing confetti.
timeline.quote: Tossing it up into the air, she did a twisted bow and sashayed for the gate.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and Kuma dodge the ogre's chains and Kuma kills him by the throat.
timeline.quote: but the wolf's teeth closed around its throat before the ogre could raise its meaty arms to defend itself.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi beheads the fallen ogre in a murderous rage.
timeline.quote: Feeling murderous, Ruzi sliced off the ogre's head while the it still lay blubbering on the ground.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister, without looking at her.
timeline.quote: he couldn't bear to look at his sister—not even as he placed her body into the mass grave

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
timeline.quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi finds baby Zi alive in a hidden cradle and reasons the Rakdos were hired by someone from the city proper.
timeline.quote: Whoever hired Massacre Girl was someone from the city proper, someone who had coin to waste on murder.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.
timeline.quote: "They killed your infant!" Ruzi said.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rejoins Kuma, who guards the baby Zi, and vows to tear down the city.
timeline.quote: "And then we'll tear it down."

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Rakdos led by Massacre Girl slaughters Cecilee's followers and kills Cecilee; Zi survives and is rescued by Ruzi.
timeline.quote: Cecilee herself was killed, unaware that her adopted son Zi had survived

citation.work: Rubblebelt
citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi breaks from the Conclave, turns to the Gruul, and Nikya declares a blood feud against the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Ruzi officially broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul

citation.work: Rubblebelt
citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rallies the Zhur-Taa and burns the Azorius South Records Hall after stealing documents on Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Ruzi later broke into the Azorius South Records Hall and escaped with documents relating to Massacre Girl, before setting the building alight.

citation.work: Massacre Girl
citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Cecilee named the child after her brother, Ruzi

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

pages_say.description: A legendary Selesnya Master Trainer who teaches young Wolf Riders, secretly trusts his wolf and bow more than the Worldsoul, and is sent to find his sister Cecilee.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

pages_say.description: Cecilee's older brother, a skilled fighter who protected her in childhood and counseled her against going to the Rubblebelt.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

pages_say.description: A Selesnya Wolf Rider who finds his sister's settlement slaughtered, kills Massacre Girl's ogre, and resolves to break from Selesnya to destroy Massacre Girl.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

pages_say.description: Cecilee's brother, a Wolf Rider who vowed vengeance and stole Azorius records on Massacre Girl.
